prompt: This 90s rock musical depiction of La bohème, had this music, lyrics and story written by a talent who passed the day before their Off-Broadway preview performance. Aside from Broadway, what was the name of his Netflix success?
answer: Jonathan Larson’s Netflix success was **_Tick, Tick… Boom!_**, the 2021 film adaptation of his autobiographical stage musical.
